This is my maize plot, small but I depend on it. Here in the North West the rains are not so plenty, so I must use fertilizer if I want a good harvest — I usually buy one bag of NPK and a little urea when I can find it at the depot. The seed I will get from the market like last year, the local one I trust; the improved seed is costly and the agro-dealer is far. I will weed myself with my sons, and maybe call one or two people to help during planting and weeding so the work does not delay.
